title: Synthetic Patients: Simulating Difficult Conversations with Multimodal Generative AI for Medical Education
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of an AI-driven simulation tool for medical students. While the simulations include sensitive topics like end-of-life care and mention patient values/belief systems as part of persona construction, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or reasoning. Ethical considerations are only mentioned briefly in the context of limitations and future work.
